units.source: Formatting toolbar
Trilium allows two different editing experiences for text notes, based on your preference.

The type of formatting toolbar can be changed by going to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and then looking for the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ section. In it, look for the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_5__ category.
Floating__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The floating bar is a more minimalist option, in which the formatting is hidden behind two different popups.
Block-level popup__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The first popup is the block-level popup. This will appear to the left of the current paragraph you are currently editing, as a sequence of dots:__TRILIUM_PH_0____TRILIUM_PH_1__
Clicking this popup will reveal the formatting options that are specific to the entire paragraph, such as setting a heading, lists, tables, etc.

The dots are also a drag handle: drag them to move the paragraph, all the selected paragraphs, or a selected element such as an image, a table or an included note to another place in the note. Right-clicking them opens a menu that copies a reference to the paragraph or to the selected paragraphs, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Block references__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The menu is headed by the type of the block it acts on, such as __TRILIUM_PH_2__Paragraph__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Table__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__List item__TRILIUM_PH_7__, or by the number of blocks when there are several. For a single block other than a paragraph, the __TRILIUM_PH_8__ button at the end of the heading opens the help page of its type in a split beside the note. Its first items, __TRILIUM_PH_9__Insert above__TRILIUM_PH_10__ and __TRILIUM_PH_11__Insert below__TRILIUM_PH_12__, list the __TRILIUM_PH_13__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_14__ that insert content or turn a paragraph into another block, and add the one picked in a new paragraph above or below the paragraph. Beside a list item, __TRILIUM_PH_15__Insert item above__TRILIUM_PH_16__, __TRILIUM_PH_17__Insert item below__TRILIUM_PH_18__ and __TRILIUM_PH_19__Insert child item__TRILIUM_PH_20__ take their place and add an empty item. After them, __TRILIUM_PH_21__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_22__ and __TRILIUM_PH_23__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_24__ put the whole paragraph or the selected paragraphs on the clipboard, even when only part of their text is selected; __TRILIUM_PH_25__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_26__ also removes them. Once an AI provider is configured, __TRILIUM_PH_27__AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_28__ follows them, with the same items as the __TRILIUM_PH_29__ button of the toolbar, and works on the whole paragraph or the selected paragraphs rather than on the selected text, see __TRILIUM_PH_30__In-editor AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_31__. Its last item, __TRILIUM_PH_32__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_33__, deletes the paragraph or the selected paragraphs at once, without asking for confirmation; __TRILIUM_PH_34__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_35__+__TRILIUM_PH_36__Z__TRILIUM_PH_37__ brings them back.
Inline popup__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The inline popup appears automatically when selecting a text:
All the options here apply only to the selected portion of text, such as changing the font size, or making the text bold.
Fixed__TRILIUM_PH_0__
The fixed formatting offers a more traditional editing paradigm, usually useful if a lot of formatting is needed.

All the options are combined into a single toolbar that will appear at the above the note. When using __TRILIUM_PH_0__Split View__TRILIUM_PH_1__, a single toolbar will be available to save space and it acts on the active note.

The sequence of dots to the left of the current paragraph is still shown as a drag handle: drag it to move the paragraph, all the selected paragraphs, or a selected element such as an image, a table or an included note to another place in the note. Releasing it above the first paragraph or below the last one moves it to the start or the end of the note. Clicking or right-clicking it opens a menu that copies a reference to the block, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__Block references__TRILIUM_PH_1__. The last item of that menu, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_3__, deletes the blocks that a drag would move, without asking for confirmation; __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__Z__TRILIUM_PH_7__ brings them back. Hovering the drag handle shades the blocks that it moves, and they stay shaded while its menu is open: inside a table, this is the paragraph in the current cell, and with several cells selected, the whole table. The menu is headed by the type of the shaded block, such as __TRILIUM_PH_8__Paragraph__TRILIUM_PH_9__, __TRILIUM_PH_10__Table__TRILIUM_PH_11__ or __TRILIUM_PH_12__List item__TRILIUM_PH_13__, or by the number of shaded blocks when there are several. For a single block other than a paragraph, the __TRILIUM_PH_14__ button at the end of the heading opens the help page of its type in a split beside the note. Its first items, __TRILIUM_PH_15__Insert above__TRILIUM_PH_16__ and __TRILIUM_PH_17__Insert below__TRILIUM_PH_18__, list the __TRILIUM_PH_19__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_20__ that insert content or turn a paragraph into another block, and add the one picked in a new paragraph above or below the shaded blocks; typing while one of them is open filters it. They are shown only while slash commands are turned on. Beside a list item, __TRILIUM_PH_21__Insert item above__TRILIUM_PH_22__, __TRILIUM_PH_23__Insert item below__TRILIUM_PH_24__ and __TRILIUM_PH_25__Insert child item__TRILIUM_PH_26__ take their place and add an empty item: above the item, below it and its nested items, or as its first nested item. In a table cell, __TRILIUM_PH_27__Insert row above__TRILIUM_PH_28__ and __TRILIUM_PH_29__Insert row below__TRILIUM_PH_30__ follow them. After them, __TRILIUM_PH_31__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_32__ and __TRILIUM_PH_33__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_34__ put the shaded blocks on the clipboard, and __TRILIUM_PH_35__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_36__ also removes them. Once an AI provider is configured, __TRILIUM_PH_37__AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_38__ follows them, with the same items as the __TRILIUM_PH_39__ button of the toolbar, and works on the shaded blocks rather than on the selected text, see __TRILIUM_PH_40__In-editor AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_41__. The drag handle is not shown in the mobile layout.

Beside an empty paragraph, the dots turn into a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button. Clicking it opens the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_2__ that insert content or turn the paragraph into another block as a menu, with a box at its top to filter them, and right-clicking it still opens the menu of the block. The button is shown only while __TRILIUM_PH_3__Options__TRILIUM_PH_4__ → __TRILIUM_PH_5__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_6__ → __TRILIUM_PH_7__Features__TRILIUM_PH_8__ → __TRILIUM_PH_9__Slash commands__TRILIUM_PH_10__ is turned on.

By default, if the toolbar does not fit on the screen, the rest of the options will be grouped into a single option at the end. It is possible to display items on multiple lines by checking the corresponding option in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section.
